opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: up to £200 (Scheme A), up to £500 (or up to £750 for Adelphi co-sponsored) (Scheme B), up to £300 (Scheme C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva (Scheme A); PhD students and postdocs within six years for Schemes B & C; UK‑based members for non‑UK conferences and non‑UK members for UK conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance at genetics‑related conferences (travel, accommodation and registration costs) for junior society members.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK (or attending a UK‑based course). Students need a supervisor’s supporting letter; supervisors must be Society members.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to cover travel, accommodation, subsistence and registration for short training courses or collaborative visits.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK (or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK). Requires supervisor’s supporting letter; supervisor must be a Society member.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel and accommodation costs for field‑based genetic research projects that aim for results suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members may apply at any time to sponsor genetics‑themed meetings held in the UK. Applicants must be Society members and provide a meeting plan.
opportunities.summary: Provides sponsorship for one‑off genetics meetings not organised directly by the Society, covering venue costs, speaker fees and optional Carer’s Awards.
